maevalia0.m: You there! This is no place for children!

maevalia1.m: The Charwood area has become a dangerous place as of late. You should leave at once unless you want to get killed ... or worse.

maevalia10.m: Our mining town up in the Charwood hills is completely overrun, however. All our belongings are back there.

maevalia11.m: There are also several of us that haven't made it down the hill. Many of our friends and relatives from the mining town have not been accounted for yet.
r: What do you think has happened to them?

maevalia12.m: I don't want to think about that. Either they've been killed by the foul monsters, or worse.

maevalia13.m: You know, we saw one monster carrying around what looked like a net of some sort, instead of weapons like the other ones.

maevalia14.m: He shoved the other monsters around, and they all seemed to look up to him, like he was some sort of leader.

maevalia15.m: I don't know what that net was for though. I wonder if he was supposed to capture some of us.
r: As I said, I'll try to find out what happened to them.

maevalia16.m: I sure hope that the people that we are missing are all alive at least.

maevalia17.m: In particular, I'm worried about what happened to Morenavia - our leader. None of us that made it back to this cabin saw what happened to her.

maevalia18.m: I sure hope she's still alive. We could use some of her wisdom and leadership right now to guide us.

maevalia19.m: I'm also worried about Falothen, our weapons trainer. As I ran down the hills myself, I thought I heard him call for help.

maevalia2.m: For your sake, I urge you to leave. While we need all the help we can get, we can't take responsibility for the dangers that has befell our mining town of Charwood.

maevalia20.m: There's also Ayell, our healer, and Fayvara, our armorer. They always stayed together, those two. We don't know what happened to them or where they are.
r: What are you going to do?
As I said, I'll try to find out what happened to them.

maevalia21.m: I honestly don't know. We've sent out runners to try to find help. So far, none have returned with help.
r: Tough luck. They're probably dead. You should move on with your lives.

maevalia21a.m: With your help, we might at least get somewhere.

maevalia22.m: Yes, I guess so. Thank you for listening to our story.

maevalia23.m: Well, I wouldn't want to be responsible for putting you into any trouble.
r: I might be able to sneak by the monsters undetected.
A few puny monsters won't stop me!

maevalia24.m: OK. Frankly, I don't know what else we can do. We really need the help.

maevalia25.m: I would be very grateful for knowing what happened to the people we are missing.

maevalia26.m: Head up to our mining town of Charwood heights, and look for the missing people.

maevalia27.m: Please, try to be safe! If you spot any danger, or if those foul monsters are too much for you, don't hesitate to retreat back here.
r: OK, I'll try to find your missing people.

maevalia28.m: Thank you. The path up to Charwood heights is just east of here.

maevalia3.m: We were attacked. We didn't stand a chance, they were too many and we are no fighters.

maevalia4.m: They started pouring out of the mine and the surrounding hills.

maevalia5.m: The monsters. Disgusting, foul smelling monsters. Nothing like we've ever seen before.

maevalia6.m: They ransacked our whole mining camp. Even burnt down the wooden carving that Morenavia had created last year.

maevalia7.m: We did the only thing we can, seeing as none of us were equipped to fight. We ran.

maevalia8.m: We ran down the mountain, leaving behind our mining settlement of Charwood. Some of us made it here to our former cabin.

maevalia9.m: The few of us that's left have been able to hold them off from here, at least for now.

maevalia_d1.m: It's good to see that Falothen and Fayvara are well. Anything else that I can help you with?
r: Where do you think the monsters came from?
I talked to Kantya about what happened in the mine.

maevalia_d2.m: Absolutely. Pick any bed you want over there.

maevalia_d3.m: I have my guesses. Go talk to Kantya about it. I hear she has the full story, and some interesting theories.

maevalia_d4.m: Good. Did she tell you about that marking on the ground? I saw it myself. Nothing like I've ever seen before.

maevalia_d5.m: I wonder what is down there, in the deeper parts of the mine. I bet that whatever is controlling those monsters is still down there.
r: I can go look down there if you want.
This all sounds too dangerous for me. I better not get involved.

maevalia_d6.m: Can't say I blame you. Thank you for the help you've provided so far.

maevalia_d7.m: You would do that for us? Thank you. I don't know what we would do without your help.

maevalia_d8.m: Please try to be safe, and be on the lookout for the dangerous monsters that inhabit the mine.

maevalia_d9.m: Whatever lurks down there, I'm sure it's not happy to get any visitors.
r: I'll go down into the Charwood mine and investigate.

maevalia_h10.m: Certainly. Here is what we can spare. Thank you yet again.

maevalia_h11.m: After helping us, you still want to deprive us of more things that we cherish?

maevalia_h12.m: I guess we have no choice but to agree. Here, take these. They used to belong to my mother.

maevalia_h2.m: Hello again. Did you reach the lower parts of the Charwood mine?
r: Yes. I encountered a dragon-like creature in the fiery depths of the mine.

maevalia_h3.m: None of us ever dared to venture that deep.
r: I haven't killed the creature yet though.
Whatever that thing was, it won't bother you any more now that I've killed it. Here is one of the bones from its corpse.

maevalia_h6.m: You are truly a hero to us.

maevalia_h7.m: Not only did you manage to find our missing people, but you also freed us from the creature that caused all this trouble.

maevalia_h8.m: We are forever in your debt. What can we do to ever repay you?
r: How about some gold for all my troubles?
I think that one of your most precious items will suffice as payment.

maevalia_h9.m: You are truly our hero. Thank you yet again.

maevalia_q1.m: Thank you for all your help!

r: Can you tell me the story about what happened here, again?

maevalia_r1.m: Hello again. Did you find our missing people?
r: Can you tell me the story about what happened here, again?
What was I supposed to do again?
Who were the people that I was supposed to look for, again?

maevalia_r10.m: Good. We are truly grateful for the help that you have provided to us from the Charwood heights.

r: I'm still trying to find out what happened to all four of them.

maevalia_r4.m: Yes, what about them? I saw that Falothen and Fayvara have returned.
r: Yes, Falothen and Fayvara were alive. Morenavia and Ayell had been killed by the monsters.

maevalia_r5.m: While I am very happy to hear that Falothen and Fayvara are alive and well, it saddens me to hear that we've lost not only Ayell, but also Morenavia.

maevalia_r6.m: Morenavia was truly a great leader for us. Now, how will we ever be able to find the right paths?

maevalia_r7.m: Things will never be the same again for us.

maevalia_r8.m: It is at least some comfort to know that we still have Falothen and Fayvara with us.

maevalia_r9.m: I hear they are both anxious to talk to you now that they're safe. You should go meet them downstairs in the basement.
r: OK, I'll go see them in the basement.

charwood1.10: I heard a rumor that some mining town in the Charwood forest, northwest of the Foaming Flask tavern, has had some troubles recently. I should try to find the Charwood cabin and find out what has happened.
charwood1.11: I heard someone mention that the mining town of Charwood heights has had some troubles recently. I should search for the Charwood cabin in the forest northwest of the Foaming Flask tavern.
charwood1.19: I have found the Charwood cabin in the forest northwest of the Foaming Flask tavern.
charwood1.20: Maevalia in the Charwood cabin told me a story about how their mining settlement was attacked by some monsters, forcing them to flee down the mountain. They are still missing several of their friends and relatives from the Charwood heights, either killed or captured by the monsters.
charwood1.21: In particular, Maevalia mentions four people that are greatly missed; their former leader Morenavia, their weapons trainer Falothen, the healer Ayell and their armorer Fayvara.
charwood1.30: I have agreed to help the people of Charwood find their missing people.
charwood1.35: The guard outside the Charwood cabin allowed me to enter the hills ahead. I should keep to the east and then head north.
charwood1.40: I encountered one of the monsters that Maevalia spoke of. The monster spoke of someone or something called 'The Thukuzun'.
charwood1.41: I have found Falothen, the weapons trainer of the Charwood heights, and freed him from the restraints that held him. He will try to make his way back to the Charwood cabin himself.
charwood1.42: I have found some skeletal remains, containing a ring with the insignia 'Morenavia'. This must be the former leader of the Charwood hills.
charwood1.43: I have found the armorer Fayvara, and freed her from the restraints that held her. She will try to make her way back to the Charwood cabin herself.
charwood1.44: I have found some skeletal remains, containing a ring with the insignia 'Ayell'. This must be the remains of the Charwood hills healer that Maevalia mentioned.
charwood1.50: Maevalia thanked me for finding out what happened to the four people that she told me about, but was really sad to hear about the fate of Morenavia and Ayell. Both the weapons trainer Falothen and the armorer Fayvara made it back to the Charwood cabin safely.
charwood1.60: She told me that both Falothen and Fayvara are anxious to see me, in the basement of the Charwood cabin. I should go see them at once.
charwood1.65: Falothen was happy to see me again, and in return offered to train me in better handling of one weapon type. He can teach me better handling of one or two handed swords, daggers, blunt weapons, axes, or unarmed combat. I'll have to chose my preference and let him know.
charwood1.70: Falothen has taught me how to better handle one handed swords.
charwood1.71: Falothen has taught me how to better handle two handed swords.
charwood1.72: Falothen has taught me how to better handle daggers.
charwood1.73: Falothen has taught me how to better handle blunt weapons.
charwood1.74: Falothen has taught me how to better handle axes.
charwood1.75: Falothen has taught me how to be better at fighting unarmed, without weapons.
charwood1.76: Falothen has taught me how to better handle polearms.
charwood1.80: Falothen offered me the chance to learn about the other weapon types, but to teach me, he needs 5000 gold and two Oegyth crystals for each skill that I want to get better at.
charwood1.90: Fayvara thanked me for rescuing her, and in return offered to train me in better handling of one type of armor. She can teach me better handling of shields, light armor, heavy armor or or unarmored combat. I'll have to chose my preference and let her know.
charwood1.91: Fayvara has taught me how to better handle shields.
charwood1.92: Fayvara has taught me how to better handle light armor.
charwood1.93: Fayvara has taught me how to better handle heavy armor.
charwood1.94: Fayvara has taught me how to better fighting unarmored, without wearing any armor.
charwood1.100: Fayvara offered me the chance to learn about the other armor types, but to teach me, she needs 6000 gold and two Oegyth crystals for each skill that I want to get better at.
charwood1.110: I have been taught one weapon type skill and one armor type skill from Falothen and Fayvara. I should go see Maevalia again.
charwood1.115: Maevalia thanked me for helping the people of Charwood.

charwood2.10: I've heard a story that the whole reason for the Charwood hills being invaded by the monsters in the first place was that something had been awoken deep in the Charwood mine. The people in the Charwood cabin say that the miners uncovered some sort of marking on the ground in a cave, with strange noises coming from below it. When they finally broke through the ground around the markings, all the troubles started. I should talk to Maevalia again.
charwood2.15: I've promised Maevalia to investigate the deeper parts of the Charwood mine. I should be on the lookout for the dangerous monsters that inhabit the mine.
charwood2.20: I've reached the part of the mine that was broken into. The air around here seems to get hotter as I get deeper into the mine.
charwood2.30: Among the fires in the lower parts of the mine, I've encountered some type of dragon-like creature. I guess this is the source of all the chaos in the mine. I should attempt to kill it and then venture back to Maevalia to tell her about it once I'm victorious.
charwood2.40: I have presented one of the bones from the corpse of the Thukuzun to Maevalia.
charwood2.50: Maevalia was happy to hear that I killed the source of the monster invasion.
